mechanism: Selegiline (selective MAO-B inhibitor at low doses) combined with methylphenidate (sympathomimetic amine) risks excessive catecholamine accumulation and potential hypertensive crisis, arrhythmias, and serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose reduction; consider alternative ADHD agents; educate on hypertension symptoms and dietary tyramine restriction.
